_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ticket 035da1eb (RFC 9821a379 AC2 + the block half of AC3): `createLayoutBlockFromFrontmatter` parses `query__TableBlock` into kind `query-table` (query = wikilink TARGET; without `_query` rejected) and reads `exo__LayoutBlock_layout` / `exo__LayoutBlock_order` on every block kind. One mutant per guarantee; each reddens exactly its axes.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/domain/layout/LayoutBlock.ts

M1_query_alias_not_target._note: `_query` read through normalizeRef (WikiLinkHelpers.normalize) — for `[[uid|label]]` it hands back the ALIAS, so the runner would look up a label as a uid. Only Q2 carries the alias form. Q7 too: `[[uid#Запрос|…]]` keeps its subpath under normalize.
M1_query_alias_not_target.from: const query = typeof queryRaw === "string" ? wikilinkTarget(queryRaw) : null;

M2_missing_query_accepted._note: A block without `_query` is accepted with an empty query instead of rejected — the negative clause of AC2.

M3_limit_ignored._note: `_limit` never read — every block gets the default 100. Q9 too: its positive control `" 25 "` → 25 needs the limit read.

M4_not_registered_as_block._note: `isLayoutBlockFrontmatter` does not know query__TableBlock — the repository would never even try to parse it.

M5_class_uid_constant_ignored._note: The parse branch recognises the class by LABEL only — a block whose class is the bare `[[uid]]` of query__TableBlock falls to «unknown block class». Q1 and A8 use the UID form.

M6_empty_text_default._note: Default empty text lost — RFC: «Нет ⇒ «Нет строк»».

M7_layout_link_not_parsed._note: `exo__LayoutBlock_layout` kept raw (brackets included) — no reference matches a Layout; every assembly axis that expects a block in a Layout reddens. A4/A12 (no linked block / parse warning) stay green by construction. A9/A10/A11 too: each attaches a block by link before asserting.

M8_order_not_parsed._note: `exo__LayoutBlock_order` never read — every block unordered, uid ASC. A1/A2/A7/A11 use uids that sort against the order; A5/A9's uids sort WITH it, so they stay green. A11 too: its numbered block 9 must lead.

M9_bad_order_silent._note: A non-integer order no longer warns (still treated as absent). A11 too: it asserts the same warning for strict-integer rejects.
M9_bad_order_silent.to: if (orderRaw != null && order === null && orderRaw === order) {

M10_lax_order._note: Order parsed with the lax `parseInteger` (`Number.parseInt`): "1.5" → 1, "2nd" → 2 — sorted ahead of 9 without a warning. Only A11 carries such forms.

M11_lax_limit._note: Limit parsed with the lax `parseInteger`: "2.5" → 2, "10abc" → 10, "1e2" → 1, silently.

M12_layout_ref_alias._note: THE review HIGH, restored in its narrowest form: the layout link is read by its ALIAS (the last part of `[[a|b]]`) — a block copied from another Layout follows its stale alias. A5's b2 alias equals its own Layout's label, so only A9 can tell.

M13_subpath_kept._note: `#subpath` left in the target — the query uid becomes `uid#Запрос`.

M14_label_query_silent._note: A query named by label is kept WITHOUT the warning that the runner cannot find it.

M15_list_query_as_missing._note: A list `_query` falls to the «required» message (the misleading one the review named).
M15_list_query_as_missing.to: if (queryRaw != null && typeof queryRaw !== "string" && queryRaw === null) {
